ourTeam.heading: Our team believes you deserve only the best learning experience.
ourTeam.body: We're dedicated to helping students and tutors connect through a safe, trusted, easy-to-use platform. Every learner deserves quality education in the comfort of their own home - and every tutor deserves recognition for their effort.

keepInTouch.heading: Take your learning or teaching journey to the next level.
keepInTouch.body: Stay connected with us for updates, tips, and the latest tutoring opportunities. Whether you're a tutor sharing knowledge or a student chasing goals, our community is here to support your growth every step of the way.

privacyPolicy.heroSubtitle: How we collect, use, and protect information on TuitionLanka.
privacyPolicy.introText: This Privacy Policy explains how TuitionLanka handles personal information when you use our website, submit a request, register as a tutor, or communicate with us.
privacyPolicy.s1p1: TuitionLanka ("we," "us," or "our") is an online platform that connects parents and students with qualified and verified home tutors across Sri Lanka. We are committed to protecting the privacy of all users who access or use our website at www.tuitionlanka.com (the "Platform"). This Privacy Policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use it, and the rights you have in relation to it.
privacyPolicy.s1p2: By using the Platform, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.
privacyPolicy.s2p1: TuitionLanka is currently operated by SOFTVIL TECHNOLOGIES (PVT) LTD (Registration No:PV102511). The Platform is managed and maintained by the SOFTVIL TECHNOLOGIES team, reachable at:
privacyPolicy.s3p1: When registering as a tutor on the Platform, we collect the following:
privacyPolicy.s3ul1i4: Race and nationality (used solely for tutor student matching preferences)
privacyPolicy.s3ul3i2: Summary of teaching experience and academic achievements
privacyPolicy.s3ul3i4: Other selling points as a tutor
privacyPolicy.s3p2: Tutors are required to submit supporting documents (e.g. national identity card, degree certificates, professional credentials, or student ID) for the purpose of identity and qualification verification. These documents are reviewed manually by our administrative team and are treated with strict confidentiality.
privacyPolicy.s3p3: Tutors create a username and password upon registration to access their account on the Platform.
privacyPolicy.s3p4: When submitting a tutor request, we collect:
privacyPolicy.s3ul4i1: Full name of the parent or guardian
privacyPolicy.s3ul4i5: Preferred tutor medium, grade, number of tutors required
privacyPolicy.s3ul4i6: Session duration, frequency, and class type
privacyPolicy.s3p5: We do not collect the personal details (name, age, or identification) of the child directly. We only collect the academic preferences relevant to finding a suitable tutor.
privacyPolicy.s3p6: When you visit the Platform, we may automatically collect certain technical data, including:
privacyPolicy.s3ul5i3: Pages visited and time spent on the Platform
privacyPolicy.s3p7: This data is collected through Google Analytics and is used in aggregate, anonymised form for performance analysis and site improvement. Please refer to Google's Privacy Policy for more information on how Google processes this data.
privacyPolicy.s4p1: We use the personal information we collect for the following purposes:
privacyPolicy.s4ul1i1: To verify tutor identity and qualifications through our manual review process
privacyPolicy.s4ul1i2: To create and manage tutor profiles on the Platform
privacyPolicy.s4ul1i3: To match parent tutor requests with suitable, verified tutors based on expertise, location, availability, fees, and stated preferences including race and nationality
privacyPolicy.s4ul1i4: To facilitate the tutor suggestion and selection process
privacyPolicy.s4ul1i5: To process first session payments made by parents via bank transfer
privacyPolicy.s4ul1i6: To share confirmed tutor contact details with parents upon successful payment
privacyPolicy.s4ul1i7: To communicate with users regarding their registration, requests, or enquiries
privacyPolicy.s4ul1i8: To improve and optimise the Platform using anonymised analytics data
privacyPolicy.s4ul1i9: To comply with any applicable legal obligations
privacyPolicy.s5p1: TuitionLanka collects a first session fee from parents as part of the tutor confirmation process. This fee corresponds to the advertised first session charge of the selected tutor. Payments are made via bank transfer directly to TuitionLanka.
privacyPolicy.s5p2: We do not collect, store, or process credit card details or other payment card information on the Platform. Bank transfer details shared for payment purposes are used solely to process the transaction.
privacyPolicy.s5p3: From the second session onwards, all fee arrangements are made directly between the parent and the tutor, and TuitionLanka is not a party to those transactions.
privacyPolicy.s6p1: We collect race and nationality information from tutors for the sole purpose of fulfilling matching preferences indicated by parents when requesting a tutor. This data is:
privacyPolicy.s6ul1i1: Not used for any discriminatory purpose
privacyPolicy.s6ul1i2: Not shared with third parties beyond what is necessary for the matching process
privacyPolicy.s6ul1i3: Stored securely and accessible only to authorised personnel
privacyPolicy.s6p2: By providing this information, tutors consent to its use for the matching purposes described above. Tutors may contact us at any time to request its removal, subject to any operational limitations this may impose on matching.
privacyPolicy.s7p1: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties. We may share your information only in the following circumstances:
privacyPolicy.s7ul1i1: With the other party (tutor or parent) once a match has been confirmed and first session payment received limited to contact details required to arrange sessions
privacyPolicy.s7ul1i2: With Google Analytics for aggregate, anonymised website performance analysis
privacyPolicy.s7ul1i3: With authorised TuitionLanka staff involved in tutor verification and tutor parent matching
privacyPolicy.s7ul1i4: Where required by law, regulation, or a valid legal process
privacyPolicy.s8p1: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide the services described in this policy, or as required by applicable law. Specifically:
privacyPolicy.s8ul1i1: Tutor profiles and account data are retained for as long as the tutor account remains active
privacyPolicy.s8ul1i2: Parent tutor request data is retained for the duration of the active engagement and for a reasonable period thereafter for record keeping purposes
privacyPolicy.s8ul1i3: Verification documents submitted by tutors are retained for the period required for compliance and quality assurance
privacyPolicy.s8p2: You may request deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us at support.tuitionlanka@gmail.com. We will process your request subject to any legal retention obligations.
privacyPolicy.s9p1: We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is completely secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacyPolicy.s10p1: TuitionLanka's services are directed at parents and adult tutors. We do not knowingly collect personal information directly from children under the age of 18. Parents use the Platform to request tutoring for their children, but no personal data of the child is collected by us directly.
privacyPolicy.s10p2: All tutors registering on the Platform must be 18 years of age or older and must provide valid supporting documentation as part of the verification process.
privacyPolicy.s11p1: The Platform uses Google Analytics to understand how visitors interact with our website. Google Analytics uses cookies, small text files placed on your device to collect standard internet log information and visitor behaviour information in an anonymous form.
privacyPolicy.s11p2: You may opt out of Google Analytics tracking by installing the Google Analytics Opt out Browser Add on, available at https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout.
privacyPolicy.s12p1: As a user of the Platform, you have the right to:
privacyPolicy.s12ul1i1: Access the personal information we hold about you
privacyPolicy.s12ul1i2: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information
privacyPolicy.s12ul1i3: Request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal retention requirements
privacyPolicy.s12ul1i4: Withdraw consent for the processing of sensitive data (such as race and nationality) at any time
privacyPolicy.s12ul1i5: Raise a concern or complaint regarding how your data is handled
privacyPolicy.s12p2: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at support.tuitionlanka@gmail.com.
privacyPolicy.s13p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for legal, operational, or regulatory reasons. When we make material changes, we will update the effective date at the top of this document. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
privacyPolicy.s13p2: Continued use of the Platform after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.
